utrecht-workplace-ev-sessions.title: Electric Vehicle Charging Session Data of Large Office Parking Lot (v2)
utrecht-workplace-ev-sessions.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial; consult the dataset contacts before redistributing transformed data)

transforms.declared-request-fixed-11kw-v1: Product default since the review follow-up: max_kw = 11; request = energy_kwh as declared at plug-in; every site session of the day is kept, including requests no schedule could meet.
transforms.asap-capped-v1: Pre-registered evaluation: max_kw = max(11, energy_kwh / dwell_h); request = min(energy_kwh, as-soon-as-possible energy over whole half-hours connected); sessions with nothing servable dropped. Uses the real departure, so it is a simulation set-up, not a decision input.

trust_boundary: An HTTPS download digest recorded by this project and checked against the repository-published MD5. Not a provider signature or proof that the sessions were measured correctly.
